nodes.title: ADR 0038: Cascade AppInstance removal through processes and schedules
ADR 0047: Create production AppInstances from candidates
ADR 0048: Copy App process and schedule definitions into AppInstances

description:
Production preparation installs independent instance-owned copies of the App’s selected worker and schedule definitions without executing application code.

## Scope

* In: Gateway definition selection, copy creation, stopped runtime installation, retry checkpoints, and ownership integration.
* Out: the clone HTTP endpoint, candidate-specific overrides, automatic synchronization, and cross-Node workers.

## Acceptance

- [ ] For an App with production `queue:work --tries=3`, a development-only Vite process, and a candidate-specific `--tries=1` override, target preparation installs only the App production worker plus production schedules under the target identity. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/InstantiateAppRuntimeDefinitionsTest.php` and Incus action `production-definition-selection`.
- [ ] Every copied Process is stopped and every copied Schedule timer is disabled and stopped, including when no first release exists; all copies receive their own IDs and runtime artifacts and preserve the supported backend specification. Proof: Incus action `production-definition-stopped-copies`.
- [ ] Copy preparation captures the selected definitions for that target once, resumes incomplete installation, and leaves completed copies and subsequent operator edits or startup intact on retry even if App definitions have changed or disappeared. Proof: `apps/gateway/tests/Feature/Domain/InstantiateAppRuntimeDefinitionsTest.php` and Incus action `production-definition-retry`.
- [ ] A naming or runtime-artifact conflict is refused without adopting another copy; removing a target cleans its instantiated runtime records and artifacts through existing cascades while retaining App definitions and source instance runtimes. Proof: Incus action `production-definition-removal`.
- [ ] Maintained documentation describes production definition selection, stopped installation, and retry behavior, and generated context is current. Proof: `composer docs-lint`.
- [ ] Changed project checks and repository suites pass. Proof: `cd apps/gateway && composer check`, and all five full no-TIA CI suites on the submitted candidate, plus focused affected Pest tests locally.
title: Instantiate App production definitions as stopped instance copies
